craft_notes: Sthāyin: gaze-withdraw (slow method — viṣṭambhita pauses: the slowest adverb of the block's end). Sanskrit: yatra sthitaṃ dravyaṃ...tataḥ kramaśo...viṣṭambhitaṃ...śūnyapadavī devi → L4 keeps placed-then-withdraw sequence. Rows: row 2 (slowly→knowing). Close: void-abode (śūnyapadavī — where the withdraw lands: not void-EYE but VOID-TRACK/path-abode: the road emptied). Rejected: 'object meditation' — killed: thing kept (dravya as the placed-thing); 'shuts eyes' — killed: withdraw kept (nirgacchati is withdrawal, not closure).

lines: Anywhere on thing placed — slowly gaze withdraw:
